reviews.title: Great Game
reviews.text:
I waited to leave a review until I had all 89/89 achievements. Well, now that I have them, all I can say is that I have loved this game. The running is fun and exciting and becomes more challenging and difficult as the run goes on. My favorite part is all the cool characters you can unlock. There is an insane amount of playable Sonic characters and some of them are very cool; you’ll easily find one you’ll play all the time. I also randomly loved the progression system of unlocking things for the badnik animal things at each level. 

Some downsides I have to the game: the gems are useless after unlocking all the building stuff. This also makes it annoying to be awarded gems when they can’t be redeemed for anything after a while of playing. If we could spend gems to buy a small amount of red coins or something that would be awesome. 
The character set is too diverse - which is great for playable characters, but the achievements that need you to do something with a specific character kind of stinks. One, for example, is the Popstar Amy or something like that, where getting the character is hard enough, but you then needed to do something that took a lot of time to get the achievement. Not knowing when a certain character will be available for unlock again is kind of frustrating when trying to 100% the achievements but that is likely not a deal breaker for most people. Another thing I disliked was the boss battles. I would typically just back out of a run if I ended up in the boss battles because they’re tedious and don’t add much to the run for the amount of time they take to finish. It’s nice having them in there as a change of pace, but for me I didn’t really care about them. They are very fun though, they’re animated and have voice lines, it’s just that it doesn’t ever change so there isn’t much reason to revisit them. 

A glitch I found was when you pause and end a run right after you hit all the arrow movements to unlock a reward at those end spring things, occasionally it would crash the game. The best part is that if the game crashed the moment you unlocked a new character, you are awarded the 500-ish character tokens as extra tokens which ends up being a huge help as it saves you the 125 or so extra that you need to be able to fully max each character’s level with.
Another random thing is if you swipe left or right really quickly in the middle of a jump over a hole or something you can make the character zip into the abyss and it ends your run. Which is funny to see when it happens.

To wrap this up, this game is great. I played it pretty much since it was released on Apple Arcade and I’ve enjoyed it and loved seeing all the awesome Sonic characters in the game. I recommend this to anyone who enjoys Sonic, endless runners, and/or someone who enjoys a casual game where you can just play and shut your mind off a bit.

Thank you, SEGA!

reviews.title: Solid runner game
reviews.text:
This game is great to pickup whether you just have a few minutes or even longer stretches when I’m trying to get a character through an event.

That said I have a couple of suggestions to improve enjoyability. It would be nice if I stopped getting character tokens for characters that I have either maxed out or already have 999 tokens for.

It would also be nice if there was a way to convert gems into either rings or character tokens. I’m currently sitting at 17k gems and can’t spend them on anything because I have maxed out the buildings and my xp modifier is maxed out as well. This leaves me with zero reason to do the daily missions since they only give xp and gems. Maybe allow those to reward rings and red stars?

reviews.title: Nostalgia and straightforward gaming fun
reviews.text: I loved the “Sega” sound as a child. It’s a core memory. This is a straightforward game play. No asking for tokens you “buy” with your money. Strategic game play gets you the stars, coins, and credits for upgrades. It’s so refreshing to play for fun and not for a run on my bank account. A great way to enjoy an old school style of gaming and have achievable goalposts in gameplay.
